ideas.pitch: A custom Linux kernel module that intercepts and logs sensitive system calls in real-time to detect container escape attempts.
ideas.problem_statement: Operating Systems: Memory management, process scheduling, concurrency, kernel modules.
ideas.title: KernelGuard: A Lightweight LKM for Real-Time Syscall Interception
ideas.why_it_could_win: Kernel-level programming is intimidating, meaning fewer teams will attempt it. By having a stable, clean, and demonstrably working Loadable Kernel Module (LKM) with a clear exploit-detection benchmark, it stands out against user-space web wrappers.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance custom packet filter and rate limiter leveraging raw sockets and eBPF maps to drop malicious DDoS traffic before it hits userspace.
ideas.problem_statement: Computer Networks: Custom protocol stacks, raw socket programming, packet filtering.
ideas.title: PktFilterX: User-Space eBPF Packet Filter and Rate Limiter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrating live network packet injection and packet drop metrics via a CLI benchmark satisfies the requirement for empirical performance metrics and a live functional demonstration.

ideas.pitch: A miniature single-pass compiler that parses a subset of Python or C into a custom Intermediate Representation (IR), optimizes dead code, and executes it on a custom stack-based virtual machine.
ideas.problem_statement: Compilers & Language Systems: AST parsing, IR generation, optimization passes, custom runtimes.
ideas.title: TinyIR: A Custom AST-to-Bytecode Compiler and Stack VM
ideas.why_it_could_win: Compilers showcase rigorous computer science fundamentals. A working bytecode execution loop with printed AST dumps and optimization pass comparisons is extremely satisfying for judges to inspect.

ideas.pitch: A high-throughput, user-space asynchronous file I/O engine built directly on top of Linux io_uring primitives for low-latency database logging.
ideas.problem_statement: Systems Programming: Low-level file I/O, driver interfaces, hardware acceleration.
ideas.title: RingBufferFS: A Lock-Free Async File I/O Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizing modern Linux io_uring shows advanced systems programming awareness, and the benchmark demo can directly contrast traditional blocking reads with io_uring throughput metrics.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight binary analysis tool that parses ELF binaries, identifies Return-Oriented Programming (ROP) gadgets, and simulates basic stack-pivoting mitigations.
ideas.problem_statement: Low-Level Security: Binary analysis, vulnerability exploitation, mitigation mechanisms.
ideas.title: ROPdetector: Automated ROP Gadget Finder and Mitigation Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Security tracks love practical auditing tools. Providing pre-compiled vulnerable test binaries along with a clear terminal report of discovered gadgets guarantees a smooth and striking live demo.
